'''''UFC 329: McGregor vs. Holloway 2''''' was a mixed martial arts event produced by the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] that took place on July 11, 2026, at the [[T-Mobile Arena]] in [[Paradise, Nevada]], part of the [[Las Vegas Valley]], United States.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Slew of UFC dates official, including likely International Fight Week card|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/03/25/ufc-events-official-las-vegas-international-fight-week/89317711007/|date=2026-03-25|access-date=2026-03-29|publisher=usatoday.com|author=Nolan King}}</ref>

==Background==
The event was held during the UFC's annual International Fight Week, with the 2026 [[UFC Hall of Fame]] induction ceremony taking place on July 9, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/04/05/ufc-329-july-11-headlines-14th-annual-international-fight-week/89475718007/|title=UFC announces 14th International Fight Week: UFC 329, Hall of Fame, more|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Mike Bohn|date=2026-04-05|access-date=2026-04-20}}</ref>

A welterweight bout between former [[UFC Featherweight Championship|UFC Featherweight]] and [[UFC Lightweight Championship|Lightweight Champion]] [[Conor McGregor]] and fellow former featherweight champion [[Max Holloway]] headlined the event.<ref name="main">{{Cite web|title=Conor McGregor v Max Holloway 2 confirmed for UFC 329: Dana White trolls Francis Ngannou ring walk with massive news|url=https://bloodyelbow.com/2026/05/16/conor-mcgregor-v-max-holloway-2-confirmed-for-ufc-329-dana-white-trolls-francis-ngannou-ring-walk-with-massive-stream/|date=2026-05-16|access-date=2026-05-17|publisher=bloodyelbow.com|author=Donagh Corby}}</ref> This was McGregor's first appearance since he broke his leg at [[UFC 264]] in July 2021, and it also marked Holloway's debut in the welterweight division.<ref name="main"/> They previously fought in August 2013 at [[UFC Fight Night: Shogun vs. Sonnen]] in a featherweight bout early in their UFC careers, where McGregor won via unanimous decision.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mmafighting.com/2013/8/17/4632014/ufc-fight-night-26-results-conor-mcgregor-dominates-max-holloway|title=UFC Fight Night 26 results: Conor McGregor dominates Max Holloway|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Dave Doyle|date=2013-08-17|access-date=2026-05-17}}</ref> [[Maurício Ruffy]] served as backup and potential replacement for this fight.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/mauricio-ruffy-backup-fighter-ufc-329/|title=Mauricio Ruffy announces he will be backup fighter at UFC 329|publisher=heavy.com|author=Adam Martin|date=2026-07-05|access-date=2026-07-05}}</ref>

A welterweight bout between former [[UFC Welterweight Championship|UFC Welterweight Champion]] [[Leon Edwards]] and [[Daniel Rodriguez (fighter)|Daniel Rodriguez]] was reportedly linked to the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/ufc-news/436891/daniel-rodriguez-goes-from-mexican-jail-to-top-ten-opponent-at-ufc-329|title=Daniel Rodriguez goes from Mexican jail to top ten opponent at UFC 329|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Ryan Harkness|date=2026-04-15|access-date=2026-05-25}}</ref> However, Rodriguez was instead scheduled to face another opponent at another date.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/uros-medic-gets-against-daniel-rodriguez/|title=Uroš Medić gets main event at home against Daniel Rodriguez|publisher=heavy.com|author=Marcel Droff|date=2026-05-25|access-date=2026-05-25}}</ref>

A bantamweight bout between [[Farid Basharat]] and Ethyn Ewing was scheduled for the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/ufc-fight-announcements/448126/banger-king-green-vs-terrance-mckinney-added-to-ufc-329|title=Banger! King Green vs. Terrance McKinney added to UFC 329|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Alexander Behunin|date=2026-06-05|access-date=2026-06-05}}</ref> The bout was originally booked for [[UFC Fight Night: Kape vs. Horiguchi]] three weeks prior, but was moved to this event for undisclosed reasons.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/ufc-fight-announcements/441619/top-prospect-ethyn-ewing-collides-with-another-undefeated-fighter-at-ufc-vegas-119|title=Top prospect Ethyn Ewing collides with another undefeated fighter at UFC Vegas 119|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Alexander Behunin|date=2026-05-05|access-date=2026-06-05}}</ref> However, Ewing had to withdraw for undisclosed reasons and was replaced by promotional newcomer John Garza.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/ufc-fight-announcements/454183/bummer-ufc-329-just-lost-one-of-its-best-prelim-fights-ethyn-ewing-replacement-being-looked-for|title=Bummer! UFC 329 just lost one of its best prelim fights, replacement search underway|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Alexander Behunin|date=2026-06-30|access-date=2026-06-30}}</ref><ref name="Garza">{{Cite web|title=Conor McGregor vs Max Holloway card gets new fight with 23-year-old set for UFC debut|url=https://talksport.com/mma/4393991/conor-mcgregor-max-holloway-card-fight-ufc-debut/|date=2026-07-06|access-date=2026-07-06|publisher=talksport.com|author=Lewis Thompson}}</ref>

A flyweight bout between [[Cody Durden]] and [[Ode' Osbourne]] was scheduled for the event.<ref>{{cite web|title=Conor McGregor returns against Max Holloway at UFC 329|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/conor-mcgregor-max-holloway-ufc-329/|author=Marcel Dorff|publisher=heavy.com|date=2026-05-16|access-date=2026-06-24}}</ref> However, Osbourne had to withdraw due to an undisclosed injury and was replaced by Alessandro Costa.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/06/23/ufc-329-fight-card-ode-osbourne-off-vs-cody-durden/90667560007/|title=UFC 329 loses fighter due to injury|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-06-23|access-date=2026-06-24}}</ref><ref name="Costa">{{Cite web|url=https://heavy.com/sports/ufc/cody-durden-new-opponent-ufc-329/|title=Cody Durden gets new opponent for UFC 329|publisher=heavy.com|author=Marcel Dorff|date=2026-06-26|access-date=2026-06-28}}</ref>

== Bonus awards ==
The following fighters received bonuses: $100,000. The other finishes received $25,000 additional bonuses.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/ufc-329-mcgregor-vs-holloway-2/456336/bonuses-paddy-pimbletts-shocking-submission-earns-extra-100k-ufc-329|title=Bonuses! Paddy Pimblett's shocking submission earns extra $100k - UFC 329|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Andrew Richardson|date=2026-07-12|access-date=2026-07-12}}</ref>
*'''Fight of the Night: Brandon Royval vs. Lone'er Kavanagh'''
*'''Performance of the Night: Paddy Pimblett''' and '''King Green'''

==Records set==
The event matched the UFC record for the [[List of UFC records#Most finishes - In a single event|most finishes in a single event]], tying [[UFC Fight Night: Rockhold vs. Bisping]], [[UFC 224]], [[UFC 281]] and [[UFC Fight Night: Imavov vs. Borralho]] with a total of 11 finishes.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bloodyelbow.com/2025/09/07/ufc-paris-tied-three-other-cards-for-a-record-after-legend-said-it-might-be-the-greatest-ufc-event-of-all-time/|title=UFC Paris tied three other cards for a record after legend said it might be 'the greatest UFC event of all time'|publisher=bloodyelbow.com|author=Kyle Dimond|date=2025-09-07|access-date=2026-07-12}}</ref>

The event generated $26,430,566 in ticket receipts, which broke the record for the [[List_of_UFC_records#Biggest_gates|biggest gate in UFC history]] surpassing [[UFC 306]] in September 2024 (which previously held the record with a gate of $21,829,245).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/lists/ufc-event-gates-10-highest-ever|title=10 highest UFC event gates in promotion history|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2024-09-17|access-date=2026-07-12}}</ref><ref name="att&gate"/>
